race.title: Cadburys Ice Cream Novices' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: NOBODY TOLD ME hacked up at Southwell on Tuesday and can defy a penalty to make it 2-2 for Dan Skelton. Moi Mon Vieux and Blue Sky Dreaming appeal most of the remainder. NOBODY TOLD ME MOI MON VIEUX (FR) BLUE SKY DREAMING
